data.description:
## Description

**What**: Discover every reference to /dso:init, /dso:architect-foundation, or /dso:generate-claude-md across the SC6 grep scope (plugins/, .claude/, CLAUDE.md). Update every match: replace with /dso:onboarding where semantically equivalent; restructure where the surrounding text describes the four-skill workflow. Verify by re-running the SC6 grep until it returns zero matches.

**Why**: SC6 mandates clean removal of the deleted skill names from documentation, agent instructions, hook scripts, and any other consumer in the plugin tree. Hand-curated edits routinely miss references in agents/, hooks/, scripts/, and tests/ — this story makes grep-driven discovery the first sub-step.

**Scope**:
- IN: First sub-step is `grep -rn "dso:init\|dso:architect-foundation\|dso:generate-claude-md" plugins/ .claude/ CLAUDE.md` to enumerate ALL consumers. Update every match: CLAUDE.md, plugins/dso/docs/MIGRATION-TO-PLUGIN.md, skills/{roadmap,dryrun}/SKILL.md, skills/shared/prompts/anti-patterns.md, plus any references discovered in agents/, hooks/, scripts/, tests/, contracts/ subtrees of plugins/. SC6 grep returns zero matches.
- OUT: Updates to consuming-project files outside this repository (e.g., a downstream project's local MIGRATION-TO-PLUGIN.md). Updates to /dso:doctor (S7). CLAUDE.md Quick Reference table updates (S8 covers user-facing doc changes).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `grep -rn "dso:init\|dso:architect-foundation\|dso:generate-claude-md" plugins/ .claude/ CLAUDE.md` returns zero matches
  ← Satisfies: "Cross-references in CLAUDE.md, plugins/dso/docs/**/*.md, and other skills' SKILL.md files are updated to remove all references to /dso:init, /dso:architect-foundation, and /dso:generate-claude-md and replace with /dso:onboarding where a replacement is semantically equivalent."

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Discovery via grep is the FIRST sub-step — do not rely on a hand-curated file list. Hand-curated lists routinely miss references in agents/, hooks/, scripts/, and tests/.
- [Maintainability] Search scope explicitly includes agents/, hooks/, scripts/, tests/, and contracts/ subtrees of plugins/, not just SKILL.md files and docs/. Run grep against the full SC6 scope, not a narrower curated subset.
- [Maintainability] Some references describe the four-skill workflow; replacing the skill name alone would leave incoherent prose. For those sites, restructure the surrounding sentence to describe the new single-skill workflow rather than just substituting the name.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, no plugin docs or skill files reference the deleted /dso:init, /dso:architect-foundation, or /dso:generate-claude-md skills
